<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
  <head>
    <meta charset="utf-8" />
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1" />
    <title>ClothCare Connect</title>
    <meta
      name="description"
      content="A simple initiative page connecting NGOs that need clothing support with shops and helpers who can contribute."
    />
    <style>
      :root {
        --ink: #17201b;
        --muted: #5c675f;
        --paper: #fffaf1;
        --leaf: #246b4f;
        --leaf-dark: #174b39;
        --rose: #c95559;
        --sun: #f0b84b;
        --sky: #dbeef2;
        --line: rgba(23, 32, 27, 0.14);
        --shadow: 0 14px 34px rgba(23, 32, 27, 0.14);
      }

      * {
        box-sizing: border-box;
      }

      body {
        margin: 0;
        color: var(--ink);
        background: var(--paper);
        font-family:
          Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI",
          sans-serif;
      }

      a {
        color: inherit;
        text-decoration: none;
      }

      .site-shell {
        min-height: 100vh;
        overflow-x: hidden;
      }

      .hero {
        position: relative;
        min-height: 92vh;
        display: grid;
        align-items: center;
        padding: 28px clamp(18px, 4vw, 64px) 44px;
        background:
          linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(255, 250, 241, 0.94) 0%, rgba(255, 250, 241, 0.84) 46%, rgba(255, 250, 241, 0.18) 100%),
          url("data:image/png;base64,") center right / cover no-repeat;
      }

      .topbar {
        position: absolute;
        top: 0;
        left: 0;
        right: 0;
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: space-between;
        gap: 18px;
        padding: 22px clamp(18px, 4vw, 64px);
      }

      .brand {
        display: inline-flex;
        align-items: center;
        width: min(520px, 70vw);
      }

      .brand-logo {
        display: block;
        width: 100%;
        height: auto;
      }

      .nav-note {
        color: var(--muted);
        font-size: 0.95rem;
      }

      .hero-content {
        width: min(720px, 100%);
        padding-top: 190px;
      }

      .eyebrow {
        width: fit-content;
        margin: 0 0 22px;
        padding: 8px 12px;
        border: 1px solid rgba(36, 107, 79, 0.22);
        border-radius: 999px;
        color: var(--leaf-dark);
        background: rgba(255, 250, 241, 0.72);
        font-size: 0.86rem;
        font-weight: 800;
        letter-spacing: 0.04em;
        text-transform: uppercase;
      }

      h1 {
        margin: 0;
        max-width: 680px;
        font-size: clamp(2.9rem, 8vw, 6.4rem);
        line-height: 0.95;
        letter-spacing: 0;
      }

      .purpose {
        margin: 26px 0 0;
        max-width: 620px;
        color: #303a34;
        font-size: clamp(1.05rem, 2vw, 1.32rem);
        line-height: 1.65;
      }

      .slogan {
        margin: 16px 0 0;
        max-width: 560px;
        color: var(--leaf-dark);
        font-size: clamp(1rem, 1.6vw, 1.16rem);
        font-weight: 850;
      }

      .actions {
        display: flex;
        flex-wrap: wrap;
        gap: 14px;
        margin-top: 34px;
      }

      .choice {
        min-width: min(100%, 220px);
        display: inline-flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: space-between;
        gap: 18px;
        padding: 18px 20px;
        border-radius: 8px;
        color: #fff;
        font-size: 1.05rem;
        font-weight: 850;
        box-shadow: var(--shadow);
        transition:
          transform 180ms ease,
          box-shadow 180ms ease,
          filter 180ms ease;
      }

      .choice:hover,
      .choice:focus-visible {
        transform: translateY(-3px);
        filter: saturate(1.08);
        box-shadow: 0 18px 42px rgba(23, 32, 27, 0.18);
        outline: none;
      }

      .choice-ngo {
        background: var(--rose);
      }

      .choice-helper {
        background: var(--leaf);
      }

      .choice svg {
        width: 24px;
        height: 24px;
        flex: 0 0 auto;
      }

      .next-peek {
        position: absolute;
        right: clamp(18px, 4vw, 64px);
        bottom: 24px;
        width: min(320px, calc(100% - 36px));
        padding: 16px 18px;
        border-left: 4px solid var(--sun);
        background: rgba(255, 250, 241, 0.86);
        color: #354139;
        box-shadow: 0 18px 44px rgba(23, 32, 27, 0.13);
      }

      .next-peek strong {
        display: block;
        margin-bottom: 4px;
      }

      .content-band {
        padding: 68px clamp(18px, 4vw, 64px);
        background: #ffffff;
      }

      .section-grid {
        width: min(1120px, 100%);
        margin: 0 auto;
        display: grid;
        grid-template-columns: 0.8fr 1.2fr;
        gap: clamp(28px, 5vw, 72px);
        align-items: start;
      }

      h2 {
        margin: 0;
        font-size: clamp(2rem, 4vw, 3.5rem);
        line-height: 1;
        letter-spacing: 0;
      }

      .section-copy {
        margin: 18px 0 0;
        color: var(--muted);
        font-size: 1.02rem;
        line-height: 1.75;
      }

      .steps {
        display: grid;
        grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
        gap: 14px;
      }

      .step {
        min-height: 190px;
        padding: 22px;
        border: 1px solid var(--line);
        border-radius: 8px;
        background: #fffdf8;
      }

      .step-number {
        width: 42px;
        height: 42px;
        display: grid;
        place-items: center;
        border-radius: 8px;
        background: var(--sky);
        color: var(--leaf-dark);
        font-weight: 900;
      }

      .step h3 {
        margin: 20px 0 10px;
        font-size: 1.1rem;
      }

      .step p {
        margin: 0;
        color: var(--muted);
        line-height: 1.6;
      }

      .footer {
        padding: 34px clamp(18px, 4vw, 64px);
        border-top: 1px solid var(--line);
        color: var(--muted);
        background: var(--paper);
        text-align: center;
      }

      .initiative-band {
        padding: 72px clamp(18px, 4vw, 64px);
        background: var(--paper);
      }

      .initiative-content {
        width: min(900px, 100%);
        margin: 0 auto;
      }

      .initiative-content h2 {
        margin-bottom: 24px;
      }

      .initiative-content p {
        margin: 0 0 20px;
        color: #303a34;
        font-size: 1.05rem;
        line-height: 1.85;
      }

      .initiative-content p:last-child {
        margin-bottom: 0;
      }

      @media (max-width: 820px) {
        .hero {
          min-height: 96vh;
          align-items: end;
          padding-bottom: 148px;
          background:
            linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255, 250, 241, 0.9) 0%, rgba(255, 250, 241, 0.76) 52%, rgba(255, 250, 241, 0.98) 100%),
            url("data:image/png;base64,") center top / auto 54% no-repeat;
        }

        .topbar {
          align-items: flex-start;
        }

        .nav-note {
          max-width: 170px;
          text-align: right;
          font-size: 0.82rem;
        }

        .brand {
          width: min(360px, 62vw);
        }

        .hero-content {
          padding-top: 380px;
        }

        .actions {
          display: grid;
          grid-template-columns: 1fr;
        }

        .choice {
          width: 100%;
        }

        .next-peek {
          left: 18px;
          right: 18px;
          width: auto;
        }

        .section-grid,
        .steps {
          grid-template-columns: 1fr;
        }

        .step {
          min-height: 0;
        }
      }
    </style>
  </head>
  <body>
    <main class="site-shell">
      <section class="hero" aria-labelledby="page-title">
        <header class="topbar" aria-label="Site header">
          <a class="brand" href="#">
            <img
              class="brand-logo"
              src="data:image/png;base64,"
              alt="ClothCare Connect"
            />
          </a>
          <span class="nav-note">Connecting need with generosity</span>
        </header>

        <div class="hero-content">
          <p class="eyebrow">Community clothing support</p>
          <h1 id="page-title">Share what is needed. Offer what you can.</h1>
          <p class="purpose">
            We believe that a simple act of giving can make a real difference in someone's life.
            Our platform brings together clothing stores, NGOs, orphanages, and old-age homes,
            making it easier for people and organizations to support those who need it most. By
            creating meaningful connections, we aim to build stronger communities and spread
            kindness, one donation at a time.
          </p>
          <p class="slogan">Clothes with purpose, support with dignity.</p>

          <div class="actions" aria-label="Choose your form">
            <a
              class="choice choice-ngo"
              href="https://forms.gle/5VkdccZhxrQThPrBA"
              target="_blank"
              rel="noopener noreferrer"
            >
              <span>NGO</span>
              <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" aria-hidden="true">
                <path d="M5 12h14M13 6l6 6-6 6" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" />
              </svg>
            </a>

            <a
              class="choice choice-helper"
              href="https://forms.gle/ERiUFAL7UGDQejsw8"
              target="_blank"
              rel="noopener noreferrer"
            >
              <span>Helper</span>
              <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" aria-hidden="true">
                <path d="M5 12h14M13 6l6 6-6 6" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" />
              </svg>
            </a>
          </div>
        </div>

        <aside class="next-peek" aria-label="What happens next">
          <strong>Choose the side that fits you.</strong>
          NGOs request support. Helpers share what they can offer.
        </aside>
      </section>

      <section class="content-band" aria-labelledby="how-it-works">
        <div class="section-grid">
          <div>
            <h2 id="how-it-works">How it works</h2>
            <p class="section-copy">
              Keep this section short and human. The goal is to make visitors feel clear, trusted,
              and ready to fill the right form.
            </p>
          </div>

          <div class="steps">
            <article class="step">
              <span class="step-number">1</span>
              <h3>Pick your role</h3>
              <p>Select NGO if you need clothing support, or Helper if you can contribute.</p>
            </article>

            <article class="step">
              <span class="step-number">2</span>
              <h3>Share details</h3>
              <p>The Google Form collects the contact and location details needed to coordinate.</p>
            </article>

            <article class="step">
              <span class="step-number">3</span>
              <h3>Get connected</h3>
              <p>Our team will match available helpers with the communities that need them.</p>
            </article>
          </div>
        </div>
      </section>

      <section class="initiative-band" aria-labelledby="initiative-title">
        <div class="initiative-content">
          <h2 id="initiative-title">Our Initiative</h2>
          <p>
            Every year, thousands of perfectly usable clothes are discarded, burned, or left unused,
            contributing to environmental pollution and unnecessary waste. At the same time,
            countless children, elderly individuals, and underprivileged communities struggle to
            access basic clothing.
          </p>
          <p>
            Our initiative aims to bridge this gap by creating a simple and efficient connection
            between clothing retailers, NGOs, orphanages, old-age homes, and charitable
            organizations. Through our platform, clothing stores can easily share details of surplus,
            unsold, or out-of-fashion garments that would otherwise go to waste. These clothes can
            then be redirected to organizations that need them most, giving them a second life and
            creating a meaningful social impact.
          </p>
          <p>
            By connecting donors with beneficiaries, we strive to reduce textile waste, support
            vulnerable communities, and promote a more sustainable and compassionate society.
            Together, we can transform unused clothing from a source of pollution into a source of
            dignity, comfort, and hope.
          </p>
        </div>
      </section>

      <footer class="footer">
        Built for a simple idea: connect need with kindness.
      </footer>
    </main>
  </body>
</html>
